points.point: Can the repurpose TikToks on autopilot template use a YouTube Shorts channel as its source
New Shorts automatically reposted to Instagram and Facebook

verdict.reason: The closest entry (remix-youtube-video) covers pasting one YouTube URL into the AI Agent as Context for drafts. It doesn't say whether the autopilot template can watch a YouTube Shorts channel and repost new Shorts to Instagram and Facebook.
